Craft refreshing paletas and ice pops in Papa's Paleteria To Go!

After winning a priceless pendant at the grand opening of Papa's Paleteria, excitement turns to chaos when Toby the Sea Lion dashes off with your cherished prize!  Papa Louie sets off in pursuit, and leaves you to run the new shop instead!  Now it's up to you to helm the operation, crafting delectable paletas and ice pops for everyone visiting the seaside town of San Fresco.  Pour a variety of purees, creams, and chunky fillings into paleta molds, and send them to the deep freeze for a quick chill.  Decorate the frozen treats with a variety of dips, drizzles, and toppings before serving them to your picky customers.  Work your way through the holidays as you serve seasonal ice pops, unlock new ingredients, and earn Daily Specials featuring delicious paleta recipes that will keep your customers coming back for more.

SWEET SHAPES AND FRESH FILLINGS - Choose a mold to craft each paleta with a unique shape, then fill it with a variety of fruit purees, chunky fillings, sweet creams and custards.  Chill the mold in the freezer to create the perfect frozen treat.

TOP AND DECORATE - Add delicious dips, sprinkles, crumbles, and decorative drizzles to the frozen paleta, turning your pops into irresistible works of edible art!
 
HOLIDAY FLAVORS - Celebrate the seasons with delicious holiday flavors!
As you reach new ranks, the seasons and holidays in San Fresco will change, and your customers will start ordering holiday-themed paletas!  Unlock a treasure trove of molds, fillings, dips, toppings, and drizzles tailored to each special occasion, ensuring your customers indulge in the spirit of the season!

SERVE SPECIAL RECIPES - Earn Special Recipes from your customers, and serve them as the Daily Special in the Paleteria!  Each Special has a bonus you can earn for serving a prime example of that recipe.  Master each special to earn a special prize!

Choose unique color combinations for each item of clothing, and create your own style with millions of combinations!

SPECIAL DELIVERY - Some customers don't want to travel all the way to the San Fresco Wharf for their paletas.  When you start taking phone orders, customers can call to place their order, and you'll hire a Driver to help take and deliver orders to their homes instead!

FOOD TRUCK FUN - After you hire a Driver, you can send them out in a Food Truck between days to serve whatever you like! You can even mix and match ingredients from different holidays in the Food Truck for creative combinations!
